sections.title: Revenue, EBITDA and EBITDA margins
sections.text: Revenue ended Q1FY25 at 21,947, having risen by 6.1% since Q1FY24. EBITDA rose by 72.7% between Q1FY24 and Q1FY25, closing at 4,691. Over the period from Q1FY24 to Q1FY25, EBITDA margins rose by 72.2% to reach 31. Depreciation ended Q1FY25 at 1,330, having risen by 13.4% since Q1FY24. EBIT rose by 119.2% between Q1FY24 and Q1FY25, closing at 3,294. Over the period from Q1FY24 to Q1FY25, Interest rose by 19.2% to reach 1,747. Other Income ended Q1FY25 at 36, having fallen by 91.1% since Q1FY24. Share of profit from Associate fell by 55.2% between Q1FY24 and Q1FY25, closing at 514. Over the period from Q1FY24 to Q1FY25, PBT rose by 41.6% to reach 2,142.
